content.title: About
content.content: Orange juice, 100%, frozen, not reconstituted is a completely natural juice obtained from fresh oranges and quickly frozen without any added water, sugar, or preservatives. The juice retains the full spectrum of vitamins, minerals, and aromatic compounds characteristic of fresh orange juice.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Flash freezing preserves up to 90 % of vitamin C, which degrades quickly in liquid juice.
The juice is made from sweet orange varieties that do not require additional sweetening.
IQF (Individually Quick Frozen) technology keeps the texture and flavor close to fresh juice.
Frozen juice can be stored at home for up to 12 months while remaining safe to drink.
Unlike concentrates, this juice does not need reconstitution, eliminating the risk of flavor alteration.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains folate
items.content: Folate is essential for DNA synthesis and cell division, especially important during pregnancy.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Contains flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids have anti‑inflammatory and antioxidant properties that protect blood vessels.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: One cup (250 ml) of frozen juice contains about 110 kcal, making it a good choice for weight management.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to oranges, such as itching, swelling, or hives.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcer disease.

items.title: Natural sugar content
items.content: Although unsweetened, the juice naturally contains fructose; people with diabetes should account for its intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thaw the juice in the refrigerator or at room temperature, then stir and enjoy as a refreshing drink. It can also be used in smoothies, cocktails, sauces, and marinades.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen juice at –18 °C in an airtight package. After thawing, consume within 2–3 days, store in the refrigerator, and do not refreeze.
